The service MemAcc_DeInit shall de-initialize the MemAcc module internal states. If MemAccMemInvocation is set to INDIRECT_DYNAMIC or INDIRECT_STATIC , MemAcc_DeInit shall also de-initialize all available Mem drivers by calling the Mem driver's individual de-initialization functions.
